name: windows-vm machine
summary: A Windows virtual machine in a container, which an agent drives over SSH with the winbox command.
manual: Create the machine once: winbox up --wait. The first start downloads about 5G of Microsoft installation media and installs Windows without a human, which takes between 20 minutes and an hour.
The pinned edition is the Windows Server 2025 evaluation, which needs no product key and runs for 180 days. Another edition, or a longer life, needs a licence of your own.
